crossRefs.note: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and…
You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before…
Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way…
How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had…
One man of you shall chase a thousand; for it is Yahweh your God who fights for you, as he spoke to you.
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.
translations.bsb: So Jonathan climbed up on his hands and feet, with his armor-bearer behind him. And the Philistines fell before Jonathan, and his armor-bearer followed and finished them off.
translations.kjv: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armourbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armourbearer slew after him.
translations.asv: And Jonathan climbed up upon his hands and upon his feet, and his armorbearer after him: and they fell before Jonathan; and his armorbearer slew them after him.
